fixes.explanation: That's it. “…Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea.” (Matthew 14:25). He's out on top of the water, headed toward the disciples in their boat. The boat was already far from land by then. That all happens during the fourth watch of the night.

Yes, immediately. “Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter.” (Matthew 14:31). Peter was beginning to sink when that happened (Matthew 14:30). He had just cried out, “Lord, save me!” (Matthew 14:30). That's what I'd call a quick hand.
